title: Collection
description: A recurring inventory container — a named program, publication, event series, rotation, or programmed channel that produces bookable installments on a defined cadence. The kind field indicates how to interpret this collection: 'series' for TV/podcast programs, 'publication' for print/newsletter titles, 'event_series' for live events, 'rotation' for DOOH scheduling, and 'channel' for continuously programmed audio or video streams regardless of carriage or monetization model. Declared in the publisher's adagents.json and referenced by products via collection selectors. Selling agents may also return copies in product and proposal responses (core/response-collection.json); adagents.json remains the authorization source.

publisher_domain.description: Publisher namespace that owns this collection. Required for supply-path verification when the declaration is read from a cross-origin authoritative document; it must match the publisher whose origin delegated retrieval. A pointer alone cannot claim another publisher's collection. May be omitted for a publisher-origin document, where that origin supplies the namespace.

collection_id.description: Publisher-assigned identifier for this collection. Declared in the publisher's adagents.json collections array. Products reference collections via collection selectors with publisher_domain and collection_ids. Use distribution identifiers for cross-seller matching across publishers.

kind.description: What kind of content program this is. Helps agents interpret installments correctly. A channel collection represents the persistent programmed stream; its installments, when present, are scheduled airings or programming blocks. Defaults to 'series' when absent.

genre.description: Genre tags. When genre_taxonomy is present, values are taxonomy IDs (e.g., IAB Content Taxonomy 3.0 codes). Otherwise free-form.

genre_taxonomy.description: Taxonomy system for genre values (e.g., 'iab_content_3.0'). When present, genre values should be valid taxonomy IDs. Recommended for machine-readable brand safety evaluation.

content_rating.description: Baseline content rating for the collection. Individual installments may override this.

cadence.description: How frequently the collection releases new installments

season.description: Current or most recent season identifier (e.g., '3', '2026', 'spring_2026'). A lightweight label — not a full season object.

production_quality.description: Production quality tier. Seller-declared. Maps to OpenRTB content.prodq (professional=1, prosumer=2, ugc=3).

talent.description: Hosts, recurring cast, creators associated with the collection. Each talent entry may link to the person's brand.json identity through brand_ref (typed) or brand_url.

images.description: Experimental (media_buy.collection_cards). Pictures for a collection card (cover art, show poster, creator avatar). The first entry is the primary thumbnail. Display only, and excluded from publisher_collection definition pins.

sample_content.description: Experimental (media_buy.collection_cards). Representative past installments or a sizzle reel, as published-post references. The platform URL implies the kind. Display only: not a creative, and not authorization to reuse the content; reference_authorization and identity_ref are not authorization here. Consumers skip entries without post_url. Excluded from publisher_collection definition pins.

url.description: Experimental (media_buy.collection_cards). Canonical HTTPS page about this collection, operated by the publisher or selling agent, for example a creator profile with full analytics. Buyers link out to it for depth beyond the card, and MAY suppress the link-out when its host is neither the publisher's nor the selling agent's domain. Display only: not authorization evidence, and excluded from publisher_collection definition pins.

special.description: When present, this collection is a special — content anchored to a real-world event or occasion. Individual installments may override with their own event context.

limited_series.description: When present, this collection is a limited series — a bounded run with a defined arc, installment count, and end date.

distribution.description: Where this collection is distributed. Each entry maps the collection to a publisher platform using host property IDs, identifiers, or both. For channel collections this is the carriage map. It is a publisher assertion for discovery, not sales authorization; buyers validate owner-sold carriage against the host publisher's collection-scoped authorized_agents declaration. Collections SHOULD include at least one platform-independent identifier (imdb_id, gracenote_id, eidr_id) when available.

deadline_policy.description: Default deadline rules for installments of this collection. Agents compute absolute deadlines from each installment's scheduled_at and these lead times. Installments with explicit deadlines override this policy. Only meaningful when installments carry scheduled_at; a continuously programmed channel collection without enumerated installments has no deadlines to derive.

related_collections.description: Relationships to other collections (spin-offs, companion collections, etc.). Each entry references another collection by collection_id within the same publisher's adagents.json.

items.description: Rejects `publisher_domain`: a related collection is a local reference, not a cross-publisher declaration.

collection_id.description: The related collection's collection_id within this seller's response

examples.name: The Pinnacle Challenge
examples.description: Competition reality collection with extreme physical and mental challenges
